notes.title: Eighth update!
notes.content:
[h1]Eighth update![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34183439/a4fcbc190d7dd78d9f400d52ef9465b29e66ca86.jpg[/img]
What's new:
1. According to your requests and reviews, we have completely replaced all the hero's battle animations! Now they look much better and more natural!
2. Added a light shake of the camera when hitting enemies. This way it feels better to hit the opponents.
3. Small fix for shop.
4. Fixed an issue with inaccurate crossbow shooting.
5. Removed a few more boars from the first location to make it easier for beginners to fight in the forest.
6. Fixed the problem with the Golem reappearing.
7. Fixed auto-aim! Now he hits more accurately + uses appropriate direction strikes (for example, blow back, if the next enemy is behind).
8. Other minor fixes.

[h2]New Trailer:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=nK-5ZmAUUoM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The sixth update!
notes.content:
The sixth update!
What's new: 
1. Added a new weapon to the game - a crossbow! Kill enemies from a distance! Collect the bolts from the enemies!
2. Fixed Achievements for finding secrets.
3. Added training in the crossbow.
4. Fixed the problem with the farmer.
5. Loot!!! Now crossbow bolts and gold drop out of skeletons !
6. Fixed a bug with the controller.

notes.title: First update!
notes.content:
First update!ːHeartSymbolOfLoveː
What's new:
1. Added support for Ultra Wide monitors.
2. Fixed acceleration at the start of the first location.
3. The borders of the first location are now in place.
4. Fixed bugs in inventory and potion slots.
5. Fixed minor problems with photo mode.
6. Fixed resetting control settings after death.
7. Training now works correctly.
8. Some other minor bugs have been fixed.
9. Fixed the appearance of the Golem after loading.
